sentences.text: Learned counsel brings attention of this Court to page No. 59 of the present petition, which is the notarised Compromise Deed dated 21.04.2023 entered into between the parties.
6. According to the terms of the settlement, the parties have agreed to mutually settle the disputes amicably.
7. The I.O. is present in person and identifies petitioner Nos. 2 to 4 and respondent No. 2, who are present in Court today.
So far as petitioner No.1 is concerned, she is stated to be over 90 years of age and, therefore, unable to appear in Court personally, however, the I.O. has indentified her through video call.

8. Keeping view the fact that the parties before this Court are related by blood and belong to the same family, the disputes having been amicably resolved between themselves, this Court does not see any reason to continue with the aforesaid FIR.

9. Accordingly, the aforesaid FIR 185/2013 dated 06.06.2013 under Sections 420/468/471/34 IPC,
1860 registered at PS-Begum Pur, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
10. The petition stands disposed of.
TUSHAR RAO GEDELA, J SEPTEMBER 18, 2023/nd
